split.seed_color_source: Training RGB only; points retriangulated from training observations at fixed RGB-derived poses
split.pose_scope: Offline COLMAP camera estimates use the full image set. The held-out mode is a fixed-camera RGB comparison, not an online causal reconstruction benchmark. The all-image production fit is not an independent validation model.

seed.scope: Predicted geometry cross-checked against another training RGB/prior view. Consistency is not independent depth accuracy.

export.source: NuRec official export-gaussian-plys output; degree-1 SPZ browser conversion
export.browser_renderer: Spark / Three.js; differs from native NuRec rendering

comparison_scope: All-RGB production fit with denser initialization, more steps and a larger Gaussian budget. Not a loss-only ablation or an independent held-out score.
